subjects.title: Letting go of being right
subjects.tagline: Trade the win for the conversation.
subjects.brief: Moments when you feel the pull to correct someone or take over the conversation. Generous thinking questions your own assumptions, asks for clarity, and makes room for another view.

subjects.title: Confusion is a signal
subjects.brief: The feeling of not understanding is an invitation to slow down, listen, and learn, rather than dismiss, bluff, or tune out.

subjects.title: Noticing the feeling
subjects.tagline: Spot the spark before it's a fire.
subjects.brief: Become aware of triggers in yourself and others, and practise surfacing them without starting a conflict.

subjects.title: When to push back
subjects.brief: Healthy conversations sometimes need another point of view. Learn to notice when a rebuttal helps, when it can wait, and how to offer it so it lands as a contribution, not an attack.
